messages:
maria: Heads up — dashboard is showing a quota/attribution mismatch after the client-lib split rollout. Acme org shows ~2x usage on 'internal-route' vs raw ingestion. Anyone seen this?

alex: saw the same in staging earlier. My guess: the TS shim changed header casing/shape so console ingestion missed the route header and fell back to default. @ryan any recent change to compact header encoding? :eyes:

ryan: yup — we switched to a compact object->header step that emits camelCase keys to reduce client parsing. We assumed server normalizes but apparently not. Repro:
```
curl -i -H 'X-Route-Meta: tenant=acme;route=internal' https://api.redwood.test/generate
# vs new client emits header name 'xRouteMeta' (camelCase)
```

nina: console ingestion pipeline normalizes to lower-kebab (x-route-meta). It doesn't recognize camelCase variants. We can add a shim in ingestion to map common variants to canonical header, but that's a bandaid.

tom: this has customer visibility on canary — seeing ~5% higher billed tokens for some teams. We should mitigate quickly.

sachin: server-side quick fix idea: add header rewrite at edge (nginx) to lowercase/normalize incoming headers so ingestion always sees canonical name. Low-risk and fast.

alex: good call. I'll spin up a canary nginx mapping in staging. @deploy-bot can you kick a rolling update for obs-proxy?

deploy-bot: Rolling update triggered: obs-proxy/nginx rev=v1.2.3 -> now. 3/5 hosts updated. :shipit:

ryan: I'll cut a hotfix for TS SDK tonight to preserve kebab-case header output and add a unit test. Also will patch py/go clients to be explicit about header keys (prevent future regressions). PRs after tests: ts-sdk#451, py-sdk#788, go-sdk#112.

maria: for rollout UX, let's toggle the client-split feature flag back for affected orgs until SDK patch and ingestion shim are live. @tom can you prepare list of affected tenants?

tom: compiling now, will DM the list and add to the incident doc.

nina: telemetry ask: add an alert if console-reported token cost deviates >10% from raw ingestion for a given org over 1h. That will catch regressions early.

alex: ops plan: 1) ingest shim for 72h 2) sdk patch + release 3) toggle feature flag for affected tenants 4) run console reconcile job to recalc historic cost for the window 5) customer comms.

maria: agree. Also add SDK e2e that checks that header emitted by the client is normalized and that console attributes the request correctly.

ryan: noted. test matrix: ts/python/go unit test + tiny e2e harness that fires 10 requests and asserts console attribution == ingestion attribution. Will open PRs today.

sachin: nginx mapping patch ready, uses header_filter to normalize keys to kebab-case. Canship with zero downtime, just rolling hosts.

alex: staging patch green, will promote to canary tomorrow 08:00 PST.

tom: drafting customer note: short explain + remediation + ETA for SDK release. Tagging affected accounts as FYI.

maria: assigning actions: @ryan SDK releases + tests, @alex ingestion shim + deploy, @nina alert + reconcile job, @tom comms + tenant list. Ping me when PRs merged. Thanks all. :pray:
